softwareProjectPricing: For software and app projects, we quote the full project upfront, then break the cost into phases. Clients pay to start each phase, not the whole project at once — so you only pay for the next phase once you've approved the last one.

academy.model: Pay As You Learn. Every modular course below is broken into individual steps you can buy one at a time — start with just one step for whatever fits your budget today, then add more whenever you're ready. Or take the full course at once for a better overall price (it's always cheaper than buying every step individually — that's the reward for committing upfront). Every step you complete earns its own Digitanotion Step Certificate. Finishing every step in a course also earns you that course's Full Course Certificate. Steps are recommended in order since later steps often build on earlier ones, but nothing is locked — you're free to start wherever you like.
academy.certificationJourney: Learn → Do (hands-on labs) → Score 70%+ on a capstone → Certify → Experience (internship placement) → Grow (alumni network).
